edition.notes: A dated Vatican delivery state of an unnamed English translation. The registered response contains the complete numbered body, articles 1-24, and two source notes. Its visible heading identifies Paul VI and the 4 December 1963 solemn promulgation, but the response omits the promulgation formula, date and subscription line, conciliar subscriptions, and notarial attestations.
